g.text: TradeSim Order — entity and shared data contracts
Record / result structures are shared by BUY and SELL
IDs and symbol are nonblank; type/time are non-null.
No mutable Stock reference, and no account mutation here.
No OrderType field: the selected use case fixes direction.
No message field: presentation belongs to Presenters.
FILLED contains ID and total; rejected contains neither.
Coherent read of available cash + ONE requested stock quantity.
cash is non-null and nonnegative; quantity is nonnegative.
+commitTrade(order: Order, expected: OrderAccountSnapshot, updated: OrderAccountSnapshot): boolean
+Order(orderID: String, userID: String, symbol: String, type: OrderType, quantity: int, executionPrice: BigDecimal, executedAt: Instant)
Dashed hollow triangle = implements. Solid arrow = stored dependency.
Dashed open arrow = uses / creates; planned links are labelled.
Final target: Java files are scaffolds; execution and integration are TODO.
